[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mindfulness and meditation are excellent tools to help cope with anxiety.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended apps:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Headspace: Offers guided meditation sessions for stress, anxiety, sleep, and focus; user-friendly with a free trial.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Calm: Features guided meditation, sleep stories, and relaxing music; also offers a free trial period.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Insight Timer: A free app with a vast library of guided meditations and a timer for tracking personal practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Mindfulness Studio: Offers guided meditations and tracks progress with a "Build Your Own" feature.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional resources:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Mindful.org: A website with guided meditations, articles, and courses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Mindfulness Project: Offers free guided meditations, articles, and resources.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. UCLA Mindful Awareness Research Center: Provides free guided meditations and resources on mindfulness.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for getting started with meditation:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Start small with short sessions (5-10 minutes).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Find a quiet space for meditation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Be consistent and aim to meditate at the same time every day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Be patient; it's normal for the mind to wander.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mindfulness and meditation can complement the user's serotonin supplement regimen but shouldn't replace medical advice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested strategies to stay motivated and consistent with meditation:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Set a specific goal for meditation frequency or duration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Create a routine by incorporating meditation into daily life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Track progress using app features or a journal.
